title: Maps between shapes
summary: Member-for-member maps written as source at build time. A map is an expression tree, so one declaration serves a database query and an object already in memory; a nested model is composed from the map for its own pair and stays one SELECT; a specification whose pair has a map needs no selector of its own; and every member of the shape being produced is accounted for or the build stops.
useWhen: An entity becomes a model, or one model becomes another. Do not hand-write a specification's Selector for a shape that has a map, and do not reach for a runtime mapper: a member it cannot work out is silently left empty, which is what this package exists to remove. If the generator is wrong about one map, declare that map's Selector yourself — it then stands down for that map, which is the way out when generated code cannot be edited.
entryPoint: public sealed partial class BedMap : Map<Bed, BedModel>
